# Submit Launch policy contract snapshots

These files are non-normative test snapshots copied byte-for-byte from Submit Launch tree

cross-repository parser and binding-schema compatibility; they are never runtime policy authority. Runtime consumers
always resolve the fixed protected `main` Git objects.
